development_object_evidence: - It is a **re-measurement, not a blind test**. The method was developed on the same WASP-62 detector-5

sign_test.rule: transits with readings in the flat bottom of the trapezoid; a transit dips when the mean of those corrected readings is below 1

fakes_independent.source: docs/transits.md (the reviewer's count, not re-run by the module)

readings_note: the module's kept detector-5 readings: each divided by the star's own spectrum and corrected by its detector-position and sub-pixel terms (fitted on the published timetable); err is the reading's own statistical error as a fraction; the fit itself gives every reading the same error, d5.scatter

stops.why: only 7 readings fall inside a crossing on this timetable; the module fits a depth only with at least 15
only 9 readings fall inside a crossing on this timetable; the module fits a depth only with at least 15

stops_note: depth and err: the module's analyse_detector rerun at that period with the published T0 (null, with why, where it refuses); depth_fixed_model: the module's model on the same kept readings with only the trapezoid's period changed, a reference only

wasp100.n_clear_rule: usable detectors at 3 or more empirical sigma

2.excluded: 280 of 421 ok readings hold an OVERFLOW pixel: the star is too bright in this detector

picture.made_from: one detector-5 cutout, IMAGE minus ZODI minus its median, resampled bilinearly onto a north-up grid centred on the star

stretch.formula: grey = 255 * clip(asinh((v - lo) / soft) / asinh((hi - lo) / soft), 0, 1)
stretch.rule: lo = median - 1 robust sigma; soft = 1 robust sigma; hi = the brightest pixel

picture.rule: of the kept detector-5 readings whose cutout is on disk, the one nearest the median time of the kept readings
